Keep reference images of yourself, pets, and characters ready to reuse in new creations—no need to upload them again. pic.twitter.com/ciHWNotBSS For developers, Flare targets speed and professional layouts, including posters and product imagery. With low quality selected, it can produce an image in as little as six seconds. Sunburst is designed for greater detail and more consistent edits at medium or high quality. Today, we’re bringing GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and the API. Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst, our two new API image models, generate images 50% faster than before. At medium or high quality, Sunburst keeps details more consistent from one edit to the next. pic.twitter.com/iNhtjqKueJ Images 2.6 also brings ChatGPT's image markup to the API, so teams can identify precise areas for changes. SVG exports prepare designs for websites, apps, and print, while a new complexity parameter controls how much planning the model applies. OpenAI recommends low complexity for most quick edits, reserving medium or high settings for scenes with many elements or constraints. Source
